g.text: Whitened innovations against a standard normal (22,742 filter ticks, 21 normal test flights)

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #666666

g.text: Each component is centred and scaled with the median / MAD from training and validation flights. Velocity innovations match a standard normal; the east position innovation is wider (a slow bias builds up over long flights), which the budget-based
